en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a long line of cavalrymen on horseback posed on a dirt road bordered by bushes. The soldiers wear identical light-colored uniforms with high, square shakos bearing badges and cords, and they hold long lances with pennant flags. The formation stretches in depth toward the right edge of the image, suggesting a ceremonial or propaganda photograph of a cavalry unit. No printed text, caption, or handwriting is visible on the image side.
